They pass behind the costal margin — 在肋弓后方离开肋间隙

text.aria-label: T6: xiphoid process — T6：剑突平面

text.aria-label: Right side: nerves — 右侧：神经
Left side: dermatome landmarks — 左侧：皮节标志
Nerve paths and band positions are schematic. Each band marks one landmark level; — 神经走行和色带位置为示意。每条色带只标一个标志平面；

text.aria-label: neighbouring dermatomes overlap. The umbilicus and nipple are placed schematically. — 相邻皮节互相重叠。脐和乳头的位置为示意。
